Name: Mermaid Lagoon - Beta
Author: djbassi
Description:
[b]Description:  [/b]Deep in the secret woods a mysterious lagoon has been uncovered. What secrets await to be discovered?
﻿ ﻿ ﻿This mod alters the Secret Woods, however if you follow the mod developer installation you can add a warp point to the mermaid lagoon anywhere. ﻿(requires basic understanding of editing .tbin files in something such as Tiled). I have done my best to make this mod compatible with as many mods as possible.


﻿ ﻿ ﻿Please leave any comments/impressions/advice, I'm just starting out and any tips would be helpful :) Working on updating this with added features.

[b]Basic Installation: [/b]Unzip the .rar file directly into the mods folder. There should be [b]two [/b]new folders add in:

﻿ ﻿ ﻿ 1) "[CP]MermaidLagoon"
﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿2) "[TMX]MermaidLagoon"

﻿ ﻿ Both folders are required to run the mod.

[b]Mod developer Installation (Optional): [/b]The "[CP]MermaidLagoon" folder just contains the messages and a slightly altered Secret Woods.
﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿-You can edit the content.json file to change from the woods to any location you want
﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿-Just edit a .tbin to include a warp map property to "<x> <y> MermaidLagoon"
﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿For ex I use
﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿  9 1 MermaidLagoon 13 24 10 2 MermaidLagoon 13 24
﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿As my Warp property for the woods

[b]Requirements:

[/b]Needs SMAPI, TMX and Content Patcher to work
